rationale: The original adoption outcome is complete. A clean repository and three representative dogfood apps each completed init, sync, and open from disposable roots. The clean fixture proved repeatable refresh by adding /about and growing from one route to two. PRcard proved curated workflow behavior in the complete viewer; Bleep proved scan-only adoption against a real app source; Seatify proved a named local environment against a real app source. Every exact viewer URL passed curl immediately before an in-app browser walkthrough, exposed the complete viewer controls, produced no browser warnings or errors, and was stopped afterward. Full core/scanner tests, typechecks, production build, package-consumer smoke, skill smoke, and reliability gate all pass. The convenient path is documented first, legacy scanner commands and explicit graph open/serve remain available, and no React API was removed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clean app completes init -> sync -> open and reflects a route change
acceptance_criteria.evidence: T007 browser proof: fresh fixture synced 1 route, added /about, resynced 2 routes, and rendered Home/About at the curl-verified viewer URL.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: At least three dogfood apps complete the same repository workflow
acceptance_criteria.evidence: T007 browser proof: PRcard 17 routes/4 flows, Bleep 37 routes/33 edges, and Seatify 76 routes/20 edges under environment local.
T002 and T007 browser evidence shows Hierarchy, Map, Flow, Tree, Saved/Target, Audit, Search, PRcard flow selection, and workflow overview from the packaged scanner viewer.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Project workflow is safe, portable, repeatable, and failure-aware
acceptance_criteria.evidence: T004-T006 tests cover versioned relative contracts, idempotent conflict-safe init, named environments, auth id only, atomic graph publication, last-good preservation, truthful receipts, graph/flow migration validation, stable project identity, and bounded port fallback.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing scanner and React consumers remain compatible
acceptance_criteria.evidence: All 309 core and 189 scanner tests pass; root typecheck/build, packed ESM/CJS consumer smoke, existing command help, skill smoke, and reliability gate pass. New graph identity fields are optional and commands/APIs are additive.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The convenient path is primary onboarding
acceptance_criteria.evidence: README Quick Start and skills/nav-map/SKILL.md now begin with init, sync, and open; lower-level scan/crawl/workflow/probe/diff/serve remain documented as advanced paths.

required_board_updates: Mark T999 done and the goal achieved.
